text:
No contract was formed, because the order confirmation was a counteroffer that Rainmaking never accepted. Costco’s catalog was only an invitation to deal, so the purchase order was the offer, and the confirmation’s “acceptance conditional upon” a $50-per-thousand loading charge made it a counteroffer under UCC §2-207(1) rather than an acceptance. With no assent and no performance, the loading charge never became part of any contract, including one at $1,500.

CONFIDENCE: 86
